title: THINKGUARD: Deliberative Slow Thinking Leads to Cautious Guardrails

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the guardrail model's safety classification performance (using F1 and AUPRC metrics) on generalized safety datasets like BeaverTails and Toxic Chat, which contain human-labeled or adversarially crafted instances of hate speech, discrimination, injustice, and harmful stereotypes.
